info.title: Zerodrift Agent API
info.description: OpenAPI reference for upload, audit session, workflow, and session group endpoints.

BearerAuth.description: Use the PLATFORM_TOKEN value as an Authorization: Bearer credential.

api.description: Upstream API profile used by Claude Code agents.

available.description: Whether this agent can run in the current environment.

displayName.description: Canonical UI label composed from the Agent provider, model, and reasoning effort.

modelProvider.description: Model provider used for queue concurrency.

agents.description: Resolved Agent Runtime IDs, one for each Workflow Stage.

workflowState.description: Current Workflow, Stage, and Turn execution state for this Session.

stageAgentAssignments.description: Resolved Agent IDs keyed by stable Workflow Stage ID.

finishedAt.description: Timestamp when the Session entered a terminal status.

startedAt.description: Timestamp when the Session first started running.

workflow.description: Workflow definition snapshot bound to this Session.

function.description: Log source or workflow stage label.

raw.description: Original JSON log entry serialized as text.

running.description: Whether the audit is currently running.
